scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && node scripts/source-check.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm --filter @remote-job-radar/worker exec wrangler d1 migrations apply remote-job-radar-prod --local
scripts.db:seed:local: pnpm --filter @remote-job-radar/worker exec wrangler d1 execute remote-job-radar-prod --local --file=../../packages/db/seed/demo.sql
